name: Pineapple, Cream Cheese and Gelatin Cake
author: Anne Brock

ingredients.name: lb. 4 1/2 oz. can pineapple chunks, drained (syrup reserved)
c. water (added to reserved pineapple syrup)

instructions:
Make and chill a graham cracker crust.
Drain 1 lb. 4 1/2 oz. can of pineapple chunks.
Add water to syrup to make one cup, bring to boil and stir into 1 pkg. of lemon gelatin.
Blend half of hot gelatin into 8 oz. pkg. cream cheese, pour into chilled crust, chill.
Add pineapple chunks and spoon remainder of gelatin on top, chill until served.
